title: Cloud Architect
description: We are seeking a hands-on Cloud Architect to lead large-scale migrations of legacy and third-party applications into modern cloud and container platforms. You will shape target-state architecture, guide delivery teams, and align stakeholders on the best path forward. Responsibilities Lead application and infrastructure discovery to assess legacy and third-party workloads Define target-state systems architecture across AWS, Kubernetes, and private cloud options Facilitate workshops with clients and architecture stakeholders to gather requirements Create migration plans and test plans aligned with business needs and risk constraints Decide platform approach and landing zone integration based on workload requirements Oversee engineering execution and unblock teams during migration delivery Pr
